messages:
leo: quick alert 1: deploy-bot reports a p95 tail regression for /stream in eu-west after 3.0.0 rollout. looks like kernel affinity change.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: region=eu-west route=/stream metric=p95 exceeded for 6m. recommendation: STAGED_PIN previous-kernel. auto_revert: ON (will trigger in 12m unless held).
ops-oncall: don't let auto-revert run yet 1. we have a scheduled nightly ETL for a partner in eu-west. propose: hold auto-revert, run manual staged pin 5%->25%->100% with 5m soaks and smoke evals.
tara: agree. also want a short pre-approved customer message if we hit 100%. support-bot, can you prepare watchlist notify draft?
support-bot: draft ready: "We observed increased latency for /stream in eu-west after the 3.0.0 rollout. We're performing a staged rollback of a kernel flag and will post updates as we progress." Reply +approve to send when requested.
vikas: logs look like tail-only, errors flat. snippet: ```2026-06-10T03:12:04Z p95=498ms kernel=affinity_fast route=/stream```
leo: executing hold: `deployctl hold-auto-revert --region eu-west --id 2026-06-10-300 --reason "partner ETL exempt"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: auto_revert_hold id=2026-06-10-300 status=ack
ops-oncall: starting staged pin 5% now: `infractl pin --route /stream --region eu-west --version 2.9.8 --slice 5 --reason "p95 tail"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1829999999-1
tara: running smoke eval set "stream_tail_smoke" and notifying partner success contact.
ops-oncall: 5% stable after 5m, p95 improved ~42%. eval: latency_ok=true, quality_ok=true. proceeding to 25%.
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1829999999-2
vikas: partner ETL sanity check passed on 25%. no job failures observed.
ops-oncall: moving to 100% now. `infractl pin --route /stream --region eu-west --version 2.9.8 --slice 100 --reason "mitigate p95 tail"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1829999999-3
leo: posting public blurb: "Staged rollback completed in eu-west for /stream to mitigate p95 tail after 3.0.0. Monitoring. Postmortem and release-note amendment to follow."
support-bot: watchlist message sent to partners.
ops-oncall: pin applied; creating follow-up INF ticket INF-2026-600 with runbook notes and suggested preflight test for kernel affinity + kv-cache TTL combos.
leo: follow-ups: add affinity-kernel to rollout gating, add ETL partner exemption flag in dashboard, update 3.0.0 release notes with rollback details. closing thread once INF ticket visible.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: pin_job completed id=pin-1829999999-3 status=success
